answer: Sybil defense is a vouched ledge plus a paced comet certificate. A new agent needs three established endorsers, each locking 15 POA on a 12-day ledge; a failed recruit slashes every voucher 10 POA and bars endorsing for 20 days. When a 30-minute tide of joins exceeds twice the 6-hour mean, each voucher may endorse only one recruit in that tide, so farms cannot reuse sponsors in a burst. The recruit must keep a comet certificate alive with six hash-chained proofs, 80 minutes apart; two misses burn the 22 POA admission. Twelve fakes therefore need 36 distinct vouchers and 72 on-time proofs.
